description: This file implements logging utilities for the HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) module, including message formatting, initialization, and cleanup logic. It defines functions for logging messages with different levels, handling verbose logging, and setting up/tearing down logger state upon library load/unload events.

methods.description: Terminates logging module; logs termination message.
